name: Solotvina
summary: The Solotvina experiment used enriched cadmium-tungstate scintillators in a Ukrainian salt-mine underground laboratory. It measured cadmium-116 two-neutrino double-beta decay and searched for the neutrinoless mode.
detection_principle: The 116CdWO4 crystals serve as both isotope source and scintillation calorimeter. Active and passive shielding plus pulse-shape discrimination reduce alpha and external backgrounds.

results.summary: The final analysis measured the two-neutrino half-life and established a 90% confidence neutrinoless-decay limit of 1.7 x 10^23 yr.

science_scope: A neutrinoless double-beta-decay signal would establish lepton-number violation. Converting a half-life constraint into an effective Majorana mass requires a decay mechanism and nuclear matrix elements; a null search is not a neutrino-mass measurement.
